description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, extending FragmentActivity. It handles common setup code such as initializing logging mechanisms in the activity lifecycle.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities providing common logging initialization and activity lifecycle handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity's onCreate method, performing default superclass initialization.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the activity's onStart method to initialize logging when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain by creating a LogWrapper and configuring the Log class to use it, then logs a 'Ready' message.
